hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-display font-black tracking-tighter uppercase
hierarchy.h3: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-mono font-semibold tracking-tight text-primary

rules: Use Monospace for all numbers, metrics, badges, and terminal readouts.
No pure #000000; background #050606 adds a tactical dark-green void feel.
Hover states must be a lighter hue (e.g. primary_hover).
Do NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards. Stick to classic terminal green.
No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or CRT scanline overlays.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Retro-Futurism (Terminal Look). Containers use solid background with 1px high-contrast borders (border-primary/20).
effects: Scanlines: CSS repeating-linear-gradient overlay on the terminal container for CRT feel.
Glow: Subtle drop-shadow on primary text or borders (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,255,65,0.3)]).
Borders: Sharp edges. border-radius: 0px or max 2px.
visual_enhancers.animations: Micro-interactions for feedback. Terminal typing effect for logs. WOTS hash chains animate filling up.

buttons.primary: Sharp corners, bg-primary text-black font-mono font-bold uppercase hover:bg-primary_hover hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,65,0.4)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: Sharp corners, bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/10 font-mono uppercase transition-all

cards.style: Flat background (surface), 1px border (border), no rounded corners. Hover: -translate-y-1, border-primary/50, subtle green shadow.

badges.style: text-xs font-mono px-2 py-1 bg-primary/10 border border-primary/30 text-primary uppercase. For 'QUANTUM' tags, use inverted bg-primary text-black.

terminal_panel.style: bg-black border border-primary/30 p-4 font-mono text-sm relative overflow-hidden
terminal_panel.extras: Add a pseudo-element for CRT scanlines.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 for grids.

grids.hero: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Left text/CTA col-span-5, Right terminal col-span-7.
grids.feed: High Density Grid Mode B. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Every card stretches h-full.

motion.hover: Explicit hover states on all interactive elements. hover:-translate-y-1 for cards.
motion.terminal: Typewriter effect for lines like 'pqc@bunker:~$ wots verify --live'.
motion.progress: Hash chains animate from '·······' to '■■■■■■■■█' using sequential state updates.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-primary against surface background exceeds 4.5:1 ratio. The primary #00FF41 on #050606 passes APCA and WCAG.

hero_bg.description: Matrix green code, use at 5-10% opacity as a background texture.

abstract_grid.description: Abstract dark cyber grid, alternative background.

meme_coin_1.description: Pixel art dog placeholder for a meme coin image.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly required for the core terminal UI, but Recharts is mandatory for the price charts. For the WOTS hashing visualization, simple CSS/React DOM manipulation is preferred over heavy WebGL to maintain the 'terminal' text-based authenticity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully functional clone of pqc.market focusing on the crypto bunker terminal vibe.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the landing page layouts (Hero, Terminal animations).
Use Shadcn UI for the dashboard, forms, and dialogs, but override their default styling. Remove rounded corners (rounded-none), apply sharp 1px borders, and use terminal colors.
The Live Coin feed should be a responsive grid using the provided dense grid rules.
Coin Cards must feature the tag badges (QUANTUM, leaf #N) as monospace terminal labels.
Create a functional mock 'Terminal' component that visually types out commands and displays WOTS hash chains updating over time. (Use standard HTML characters like ■ and █ for hash chains)
Implement the 'Launch a coin' form using Shadcn forms, styled with the dark terminal aesthetic.
Price charts on the detail page should use Recharts with a custom tooltip matching the terminal aesthetic (black bg, green border).
IMPORTANT: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational elements (buttons, inputs, coin cards, tabs).
Use lucide-react icons, but keep them sparse. Let the monospace typography do the heavy lifting.
The workspace uses .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write React components using standard .jsx/.js syntax and standard prop-types if necessary, but keep it strictly Javascript.
Always set a solid background for sticky headers or dropdowns. Never use a complete transparent background.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' AI slop outputs. Emphasize the Retro-Futurism/Terminal bunker aesthetic. Make it look like a highly classified crypto launchpad.
Do NOT center align the app container. Left-align dense data, right-align numbers/metrics where appropriate.
Never use generic emojis. Use actual technical icons or ASCII characters.
Create depth through layered design (ambient + direct shadow). E.g., glowing green text shadows.
Apply transitions specifically to interactive properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform), NEVER use 'transition-all'.
Prioritize pre-existing Shadcn components, heavily adapting their appearance to fit the strict sharp-edge, neon-on-black theme.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.spacing: 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Empty space is critical to making dense terminal data digestible.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align data and text. Right-align numerical values in tables/lists.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.feedback: Every user action (click, hover) must have an immediate visual change (color invert, border glow).
